* **pm stops editing OpenSpec's generated files; its clause lives in the managed block.** In a repo with `openspec/`, the managed rules block gains an `## OpenSpec addenda` section (about 260 bytes, plus up to three guardrail bullets for `/opsx:onboard`, `/opsx:verify` and `/opsx:bulk-archive`, each only when that generated skill exists; 0 bytes without `openspec/`). It carries the archive-check clause that used to be hand-edited into `.claude/skills/openspec-archive-change/SKILL.md` and `.claude/commands/opsx/archive.md`, which `openspec update` rewrites. Run `write-rules` or `/pm:upgrade` to refresh the block.
* **The brief and `/pm:upgrade` report two read-only findings.** `OpenSpec addenda RESIDUAL` names a generated file that still holds pm text; `OpenSpec addenda MISSING` says the repo uses OpenSpec but the block has no addenda section. Neither writes anything, and the last line points at `openspec update --dry-run`.
* **`/pm:upgrade` step 4 now says run `openspec update` first, then `/pm:upgrade`.** The HOLD line in the brief reads "review before running" instead of "hold until archived", and an untracked-files line points at `--dry-run` instead of "copy them aside".
* **Unchanged.** The engine still never runs `openspec`; no new verb, flag or `state.json` field, so no migration.
